claims.text: A data-driven machine-learning approach can integrate high-throughput experimental data with process-parameter optimization for multiphase alloys.
The proposed approach can control phase stability.
The proposed approach can refine alloy microstructure.
The proposed approach can optimize material properties.
The starting material is a metastable multiphase metallic or ceramic alloy.
The starting material was previously processed using conventional sequential heat-treatment and deformation steps.
A machine-learning model using high-throughput experimental data can optimize combined thermomechanical-treatment parameters.
The model can optimize rapid heating, cooling, and controlled-deformation parameters in real time.
Rapid thermal cycling and severe plastic deformation can be applied in an integrated dynamic thermomechanical regime within a calibrated data range.
Integrated processing produces simultaneous evolution of phase constitution, grain structure, and defect distribution.
The model predicts and tunes interdependencies between thermal and mechanical processing parameters.
Model-guided treatment favors beneficial phase transformations.
Model-guided integrated processing produces concurrent grain refinement that traditional sequential methods cannot achieve.
The resulting material has greater phase stability than conventionally processed material.
The resulting material has a finer and more uniform microstructure than conventionally processed material.
The resulting material has improved mechanical and thermal properties compared with conventionally processed material.
Separated heat treatments and deformation steps do not optimize phase stability and microstructure concurrently.
The approach is effective only for processing parameters and material systems having sufficient high-throughput data coverage.
Predictive accuracy may diminish outside the calibrated data regime.
The magnitudes of property improvement and microstructural refinement remain uncertain pending experiments across material systems.
